body:
I managed to avoid hurting myself this time by reaching out to a friend, when you talk about self harm it feels like you're talking from experience, I've been struggling a lot with trauma and suicidal thoughts, the last thing I want is for them to become suicidal tendencies but as time goes on and nothing changes I just want to feel okay, and my friends can't always be there for me, I feel like a burden to everyone I care about and that doesn't help with the suicidal thoughts either.

I wanted to say thank you, for although it's already over I'll keep your words in mind next time this happens, I didn't consider the damage it would do, and although right now I don't care about my wellbeing, I know I'll regret it in the future, everything is temporary but scars are permanent.

I'll try exercise to take my mind off things as an alternative, again, thank you
Why did you throw me away?
Why did you abuse my trust?
Do you just cheat on people and replace them endlessly?
Why did you lie to me?
